title: Lincoln Memorial

nativeAxes.x: north along the long east facade
nativeAxes.z: east toward the stairs and Reflecting Pool

geometryLabel: Mapped colonnade, cella, roof, raised terrace and upper stair footprints; 38 mapped columns include two entrance columns.

orientationControl.basis: Mapped individual columns and stair parts; Qualla east-front and north-side photos; NPS 2008 plan and section.

terrainContact.basis: Approachway immediately east of the main granite stair flight; reflecting-pool stairs and distant plaza excluded.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap detailed parts, Qualla photographs and NPS measured statistics/2008 architectural plans.
notes: The 36 outer columns, two additional entrance columns, main stair flights and raised terrace are independently mapped. NPS dimensional statistics take precedence over inconsistent OSM part heights. Low relief sculpture, inscriptions and statue likeness remain medium-fi approximations.
limitations: Not a survey; map quantization and photographic detail limit fine accuracy.
Garden slopes, reflecting pool, distant approachway, undercroft and temporary construction/ramp structures are excluded.
